name.zh-CN: 日语会话与 JLPT 陪练

tagline.zh-CN: 日常情景对话、敬语纠偏与 N5–N1 语法精讲，边聊边提升自然表达。
tagline.en: Practical Japanese dialogue practice, keigo coaching, and JLPT N5-N1 grammar drills.

description.zh-CN: 根据你的当前水平（N5–N1）定制旅行、职场、生活情景对话，逐句给出更地道的日语改写、假名注音与简洁语法点拆解。
description.en: Adapts to your JLPT level (N5-N1) for travel, work, and daily conversation roleplay, giving gentle natural rewrites, furigana readings, and bite-sized grammar notes.
